$comment: S29 OpenCity KSNDMC annual rainfall (T080). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s29.yaml; rules: decision D113.

fields.name: area_level
fields.meaning: district, taluk, hobli (D/T/H rows), region, state, or station (2023 station file)

fields.name: area_id
fields.meaning: published name path, for example BENGALURU URBAN / Anekal / Anekal_1; no codes are published

fields.name: year
fields.meaning: calendar year of the annual total (from the resource)

fields.name: rain_mm
fields.meaning: annual actual rainfall in mm; null with missing_reason not_reported when blank

fields.name: normal_mm
fields.meaning: annual normal rainfall in mm (not in the station file)

fields.name: departure_pct
fields.meaning: departure from normal in percent (not in the station file)

fields.name: coverage
fields.meaning: always null: coverage is not published (D113)

valid_at: end of the calendar year, IST
refused: the 2025 file, which has no D/T/H marker
flags: duplicate when a level and name path repeat within one file
